request.content:
Requests:
[t0] Please treat this message as a request for permanent account deletion. Please review the account data that is eligible for deletion or de-identification. Please send a confirmation after the process finishes.
[t1] Solicito a exclusão permanente da conta associada a este e-mail. Verifiquem os identificadores atuais e anteriores conforme o processo de privacidade. Por favor, confirmem o resultado quando a análise terminar.
[t2] Solicito la eliminación permanente de la cuenta asociada a este correo. Revisen los identificadores actuales y anteriores según su política de privacidad. Por favor, confirmen el resultado cuando termine la revisión.
[t3] The account itself is gone, but an internal deleted-account record still shows my personal details. Please keep only the reference needed for retained records and remove the rest.
[t4] The mobile number on my profile is out of date. Please replace it with the new one and leave the account active.
[t5] The privacy page still says my request failed. Please inspect the actual systems and tell me whether the account and identifiable analytics data have already been removed.
[t6] このメールアドレスに関連するアカウントの完全な削除を依頼します。 プライバシー手続きに従い、現在および過去の識別情報を確認してください。 確認が完了したら結果をお知らせください。
[t7] 이 이메일 주소에 연결된 계정의 영구 삭제를 요청합니다. 개인정보 처리 절차에 따라 현재 및 이전 식별자를 검토해 주세요. 검토가 완료되면 결과를 확인해 주세요.
